semantics.sourceBinding: For work/node@2, each observed source binds to the owning node's direct sourceRefs by exact repository, normalized relative path and full revision. Another path, ancestor/sibling citation or repository resource cannot substitute for the owning citation. Conflicting revisions for the same repository/path fail. Legacy work/node@1 retains its referenced repository resource/revision binding. No source file or Git object is read by this metadata check; the operator verifies source truth. Accepted-intent and proposal citations are not observed code and do not require a sourceRefs duplicate.
semantics.scope: Impact inventory is not a grant to edit every listed file. Only accepted change rows may become implementation ceilings; preserve/review rows remain protected/read-only.
semantics.truth: Observed source is not approved intent. Proposed checks are not executed evidence.
semantics.quality: Lint/typecheck/tests/coverage/build/Sonar are owned and run by interface.implement or backend.implement.
semantics.limits: This validator checks shape, IDs, join coverage and declared readiness, not source truth, authorization correctness or actual runtime security.
semantics.journeys: Business authors the canonical executable user journeys; architecture preserves accepted journeys. These objects are copied directly into frontend workflow input.journeys. Internal service-call flow steps remain in flows/serviceCalls and never become browser actions by inference.
